info.title: dotnet orionguard - FluentValidation to OrionGuard migration codemod
info.description: FluentValidation to OrionGuard migration codemod, packaged as a dotnet tool (dotnet orionguard migrate). Reads C# sources with Roslyn, finds AbstractValidator<T> classes, and rewrites their RuleFor chains onto the OrionGuard FluentStyleValidator compatibility surface. Reports anything it cannot safely migrate instead of guessing.

options.name: --report
options.description: Print the proposed diff and report without writing files.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write the migrated files in place.

options.name: --include
options.description: File-name glob used when <path> is a directory (default *.cs).

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
BEHAVIOUR:
Finds classes deriving from AbstractValidator<T> and rewrites their RuleFor chains
onto the OrionGuard FluentStyleValidator compatibility surface. Any rule or construct
with no safe equivalent (for example SetValidator, RuleForEach, ScalePrecision, async
predicates) is left untouched, marked with a TODO comment, and listed in the summary.
If neither --report nor --apply is given, the tool defaults to --report so it never
writes by accident.
EXIT CODES:
0  Migration completed; nothing needs manual follow-up.
1  Migration ran but at least one construct needs manual follow-up.
2  Usage error (bad arguments or a path that does not exist).

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A directory to scan recursively, or a single .cs file.
